reviewType: independent content and figure review; same-family provisional
independence: Reviewer did not write these four reports. Production content remained read-only. Only this review record was written.
scope: Four reports, their cited primary mechanisms, author/institution blocks, publication and resource statements, all reported equations and numerical comparisons, and eight original figures.
limitations: No training or simulator execution, dataset download, or reproduction was performed.
No external peer review is claimed.
The full release build, browser QA, deduplication ledger, and deployment remain the parent executor's responsibility.
Public-resource statements were checked against recorded official README/pages and live arXiv entrances; large downloads and absent own-model artifacts were not fabricated as verified.

findings.location: frontmatter.source and 后续跟进/来源与资源记录
findings.finding: The report labels Bug2Scenario only as a preprint, but its fixed-version arXiv record explicitly states Accepted at APSEC 2026.
findings.evidence: Live https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06229v1 Comments, independently opened on 2026-11-06; acceptance is an author declaration, not verification of a proceedings destination.
findings.requestedChange: Record APSEC 2026 acceptance as the author's arXiv comment, retain the fixed arXiv link, and state that a formal proceedings page has not been verified. Correct both source metadata and the final source paragraph.
findings.resolution: Reopened changed frontmatter.source and final source paragraph. Both now say APSEC 2026 author acceptance declaration and formal proceedings page not verified; matches live fixed-version arXiv Comments.

findings.location: 方法和系统设计/语义准确与表面位置同时约束
findings.finding: The phrase 0.4 m window is ambiguous about half-width. Appendix B uses |d_i-d*_r| <= 0.4 m.
findings.requestedChange: Prefer ±0.4 m around the ground-truth hit depth or state the inequality.
findings.resolution: Reopened changed ray-loss paragraph. It now explicitly states ±0.4 m, total width 0.8 m, consistent with Appendix B inequality.

findings.location: 实验结论与证据/NAVSIM 日志评估与 CARLA 闭环分开读
findings.finding: The report correctly limits the TCP comparison to RFWorld's own table. However the already-cited WoTE primary source, Table 2, reports Bench2Drive success 31.36% and DS 61.71. This is useful context for RFWorld's identical success 31.36% and DS 62.38.
findings.requestedChange: Optionally add the direct predecessor's published results while explicitly noting the cross-paper, unmatched training-budget comparison and that RFWorld did not re-evaluate WoTE in its closed-loop table.
findings.resolution: Reopened added closed-loop comparison. WoTE31.36%/61.71 versus RFWorld31.36%/62.38 and 0.67 difference match WoTE Table2 and RFWorld Table2. Unmatched training-budget caveat is explicit. Verified actual WoTE table anchor S3.T2 in cached HTML and corrected report link.
